name: Dusty SP-12 garage house kit
desc: Deep-house kit on the EmuSP12: soft dusty four-on-the-floor, late-swung lo-fi hats, a lazy clap on 3, and ghost-note kick pickups every other bar. Larry Heard / Mr. Fingers basement warmth rather than big-room punch; peak doubles the hats and opens them.

dust.doc: hat lpf ceiling Hz — lower = dustier

code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("EmuSP12").shape(.4).gain(${gain}), s("bd(2,16,7)").bank("EmuSP12").speed(.9).gain(${gain}*.4), s("[hh hh]*4").bank("EmuSP12").lpf(sine.range(${dust}*.7, ${dust}).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(.2,.4).fast(4)).late("[0 .03]*4"), s("~ oh ~ [oh oh]").bank("EmuSP12").gain(.3), s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(.46).room(.3), s("sh*16").gain(".2 .1 .16 .1").late("[0 .02]*8")).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
